headline: Zen and the Art of Pet Food

result.label: A leading brand in independent pet stores
result.note: No figure published; the result is market position

summary: A regional pet retailer wanted to grow its footprint and shrink its footprint. We named, positioned and branded Lotus — now a leading brand in independent pet stores across the U.S. and Asia.

question.h: Grow the footprint, shrink the paw-print.
question.p: Centinela Feed & Pet, a regional pet retailer, wanted to expand its sales footprint while shrinking its carbon paw-print. They needed a way to accelerate growth while keeping the planet thriving with their sustainable kibble.

made.h: A name, a position, a brand.
made.p: Based on consumer input and strategic insights, we named, positioned, and branded Lotus as a healthy, high-end alternative to grocery brands. Through eco-friendly packaging, in-store signage, storytelling, sampling, advertising and activations, Lotus has become a leading brand in independent pet stores throughout the U.S. and Asia.
